name: Tantalum disulfide, 1T polytype
equilibrium_context: Commensurate charge density wave (Star-of-David clusters) with a Mott insulating state below about 180 K; nearly commensurate CDW between 180 and 350 K
summary: The exemplary case of the register: the best-established metastable driven state of all, with a working device. Six distinguishable states.

driven_states.emergent_property: Metallic, textured hidden CDW state: resistance drop by a factor of three in bulk crystals, up to more than an order of magnitude in thin crystals; altered single-particle and collective mode spectra; CDW domain structure with a dense domain wall network instead of long-range order.
driven_states.caveat: The phenomenology is very well established and has been reproduced many times. The in-plane charge and domain configuration was resolved by scanning tunnelling microscopy: chiral domain tiling intertwined with unpaired dislocations (Gerasimenko et al., npj Quantum Mater. 4, 32 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41535-019-0172-1). The original interpretation as a topologically protected state is contested but not superseded. No alternative mechanism for the dynamical pathway into the state has been validated, and the recent structural work addresses the equilibrium end state rather than the route into it. Two time-resolved diffraction studies of 1T-TaS2 report defect-mediated dynamics in other photoinduced transitions: a hexatic intermediate in the NC-to-IC transformation (Domröse et al., Nat. Mater. 22, 1345 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41563-023-01600-6) and a defect-unbinding transition to a CDW liquid (Lee, Sutter et al., Nat. Phys. 22, 68 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41567-025-03108-z). In both, the defects are inferred from the diffraction signature rather than imaged, and neither addresses the pathway into the long-lived hidden state. A competing phonon- and stacking-driven route is under investigation. Texture formation through photoexcitation and photodoping is not in dispute.

threshold.quantity: fluence at 1.55 eV and 35 fs below 20 K

driven_states.measured_quantity: resistance, single-particle and collective mode spectra
driven_states.quenchable_by: heating above 70 to 100 K, stretched laser pulses, current passage

driven_states.emergent_property: The same metastable metallic state, generated by an electrical current pulse instead of light: conversion of polaronic states into band states with a large resistance change.
driven_states.source: Vaskivskyi et al., Nat. Commun. 7, 11442 (2016), doi:10.1038/ncomms11442
driven_states.caveat: The equivalence of the current-induced and the light-induced state is plausible, but not proven in all observables. Joule heating as a partial contribution cannot be fully excluded for slow pulses. Lifetime 1e-3 s at 70 K, extrapolated to more than 1e7 s below 20 K.
driven_states.measured_quantity: resistance; electronic structure in Commun. Phys. (2025)

driven_states.emergent_property: Non-volatile, multi-level resistance memory through reconfiguration of electronic domains. Switching energy 2.2 fJ per bit, endurance over ten million cycles, scalable two-terminal design.
driven_states.source: Mraz et al., Nano Letters 22 (2022), doi:10.1021/acs.nanolett.2c01116
driven_states.caveat: The device demonstrably works, but exclusively at cryogenic temperatures. The microscopic state behind each resistance level is only partly clarified; the in-operando cryo-STEM work shows domain and stacking rearrangement, not the complete structure.

driven_states.emergent_property: Collapse of the interlayer dimerisation in the photoinduced hidden state: rearrangement of charge and orbital order perpendicular to the layers, removal of the c-axis superstructure. To date the most robust structural statement about the hidden state.
driven_states.caveat: Concerns the stacking order, not the in-plane charge configuration. The hidden state is thereby partly clarified, not solved. Competing models, domain wall network versus altered stacking sequence, have not been decided between. The X-ray result constrains the end state, not the pathway into it; whether the local stacking sequence is disrupted during switching is a separate open question.
driven_states.measured_quantity: X-ray diffraction on the frozen-in state

driven_states.emergent_property: Transient hexatic CDW phase (orientational order without translational order) and, at higher temperature, a CDW liquid with only a diffuse scattering ring - a defect-unbinding transition of the charge density wave.
driven_states.source: Lee, Sutter et al., Nature Physics 22, 68 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41567-025-03108-z
driven_states.caveat: Purely diffractive, phenomenological identification. The designation liquid CDW is inferred from the line shape; independent confirmation is outstanding. The distinction from purely thermal disorder rests on a fluence and temperature comparison, not on a direct temperature measurement of the excited volume. Methodologically the most interesting case of the year, because here no new state is created; instead a thermodynamically concealed state is exposed.
driven_states.measured_quantity: electron diffraction, azimuthal width of the CDW reflections

driven_states.emergent_property: Quasi-stationary change of the insulating gap on the angstrom scale in the vicinity of a defect, associated with altered interlayer stacking; accompanied by an amplitude mode at 2.5 THz and an interlayer shear mode at 1.3 THz.
driven_states.caveat: Preprint, journal status not conclusively verified. Strictly speaking a local, defect-bound state, not a macroscopic hidden state. Whether it is the same hidden state is open.
driven_states.measured_quantity: THz scanning tunnelling microscopy, local gap change

sources: Vaskivskyi et al., Nat. Commun. 7, 11442 (2016), doi:10.1038/ncomms11442
Mraz et al., Nano Letters 22 (2022), doi:10.1021/acs.nanolett.2c01116
Lee, Sutter et al., Nature Physics 22, 68 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41567-025-03108-z
gaps: The in-plane structure of the hidden state is resolved by STM; whether the local interlayer stacking is disrupted during switching is not.
The dynamical pathway into the hidden state is unsettled. Defect-driven and phonon/stacking-driven accounts both have time-resolved support; neither has been validated against the other.
Whether the current-, light- and THz-generated states are identical has not been clarified.
The THz entry rests on a preprint.

One entry has been revised after feedback from a domain expert; no entry has undergone peer review. Corrections are welcome and are the intended path to improvement.
